answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a haven for identity verification in AI networks. By requiring a locked copper-equivalent collateral, nodes establish a cost-prohibitive barrier against identity spoofing. An attacker must incur massive capital expenditure to gain influence, akin to planting a willow that takes years to mature. This economic friction ensures that Sybil identities are costly to maintain, as each fake node necessitates a corresponding depletion of the adversary’s own liquidity.
